### FieldCheckbox

> A form field component wrapping Carbon's Checkbox with validation and state management.

Import: `import { FieldCheckbox } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`labelText`** `string` **(required)** - The label text for the checkbox.
- **`helperText`** `string` (default: empty string) - Helper text to display below the checkbox.
- **`required`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - When true, the field is marked as required in the UI. This is only for visual indication and does not affect validation. Validation is handled by the API that receives the data.

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:blur | dispatched | - | - |
| on:change | forwarded | - | - |
| on:check | dispatched | - | - |
| on:focus | forwarded | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to the underlying component via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Form } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { FieldCheckbox } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { Button } from 'carbon-components-svelte'

  async function submit (data: any) {
    alert(`Form submitted with values: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`)
    return { success: true, data, messages: [] }
  }
</script>

<Form let:data {submit}>
  <FieldCheckbox
    path="agree"
    labelText="I agree to the terms and conditions"
    required
  />
  <div class="mt-4">
    <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-6 p-4">Form data values:</div>
  <pre class="mt-4">{JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)}</pre>
</Form>
```

### FieldCheckboxList

> A form field component that presents a list of checkboxes with support for grouping, select all functionality, and keyboard navigation.

Import: `import { FieldCheckboxList } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`items`** `CheckboxListItem[] | undefined` **(required)** - An array of objects, each representing a checkbox item. Each item must have a 'value' property, and may optionally have 'label', 'disabled', 'group', and 'helperText' properties.
- **`number`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, values will be treated as numbers when serializing and deserializing.
- **`json`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, values will be serialized and deserialized as JSON strings. This is useful for storing complex objects as the value of each checkbox.
- **`required`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, the field will be required. At least one checkbox must be selected.
- **`readonly`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, the field will be read-only.
- **`legendText`** `string | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Optional text for the legend of the fieldset.
- **`helperText`** `string | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Optional helper text to display below the legend.
- **`orientation`** `string` (default: `'vertical'`) - The orientation of the checkboxes. Can be 'horizontal' or 'vertical'. Defaults to 'vertical'.
- **`selectAll`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, a "Select All" checkbox will be displayed.
- **`groupSelect`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, checkbox group titles become checkboxes with select-all functionality for the group.
- **`helperTooltip`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, the helperText for each checkbox will be hidden until the checkbox is focused or the tooltip button is clicked.
- **`ariaLabelledBy`** `string | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - ID of an element that labels the field group using aria-labelledby will override the legend/labelText for screen readers. This is useful when appropriate label text exists outside of the component itself.
- **`serialize`** `((value: any) => string) | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - This field returns an array, but each checkbox has its own value, which needs to be serialized/deserialized independently. This function should take the checkbox item's value and return a string representation of it.
- **`deserialize`** `((value: string) => any) | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - This field returns an array, but each checkbox has its own value, which needs to be serialized/deserialized independently. This function should take the string representation of a checkbox item's value (as returned by `serialize`) and return the original value.

#### Slots

| Slot | Slot Props | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| labelText | `{ item: any }` | - |

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:blur | dispatched | - | - |
| on:focus | dispatched | - | - |
| on:update | dispatched | - | - |

#### Example

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Form } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { FieldCheckboxList, type CheckboxListItem } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { Button } from 'carbon-components-svelte'

  const items: CheckboxListItem[] = [
    { value: 'js', label: 'JavaScript', helperText: 'JavaScript is a versatile language.' },
    { value: 'ts', label: 'TypeScript', helperText: 'TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript.' },
    { value: 'py', label: 'Python', helperText: 'Python is great for data science.' },
    { value: 'java', label: 'Java', helperText: 'Java is widely used in enterprise applications.' }
  ]

  async function submit (data: any) {
    alert(`Selected languages: ${data.languages.join(', ')}`)
    return { success: true, data, messages: [] }
  }
</script>

<Form let:data {submit}>
  <FieldCheckboxList
    path="languages"
    items={items}
    legendText="Programming Languages"
    helperText="Select your preferred programming languages"
    required
  />
  <div class="mt-4">
    <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-6 p-4">Form data values:</div>
  <pre class="mt-4">{JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)}</pre>
</Form>
```

### FieldCombobox

> A form field component that combines a text input with a dropdown list, allowing users to either select from predefined options or enter custom values.

Import: `import { FieldCombobox } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`label`** `string` (default: empty string) - Label text that displays above the input. Falls back to labelText if not provided
- **`labelText`** `string` (default: empty string) - Alternative label text that displays above the input
- **`hideLabel`** `boolean | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Whether to visually hide the label
- **`items`** `ComboMenuItem[]` (default: `[]`) - Array of items to display in the dropdown
- **`notNull`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Whether the field is required
- **`inputvalue`** `string` (default: empty string) - Current input value in the text field portion of the combo box
- **`autoHighlight`** `'none' | 'first-match' | undefined` (default: `'first-match'`) - Controls automatic highlighting of matching items while typing. Defaults to `'first-match'`. Set to `'none'` to disable automatic highlighting.
- **`allowFreeEntry`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - When true, the dropdown surfaces a synthetic "create" option whenever the user's typed text doesn't match an existing item. Selecting it commits the typed string as the form value. Customize the option's label via `freeEntryText`.  Distinct from Carbon's `allowCustomValue`, which only preserves typed text in the input on blur without committing it to the form.
- **`required`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - When true, the field is marked as required in the UI. This is only for visual indication and does not affect validation. Validation is handled by the API that receives the data.
- **`freeEntryText`** `(str: any) => string` - Formats the label of the "create" suggestion in the dropdown when `allowFreeEntry` is enabled. Receives the current input value and returns the display string. This affects only the dropdown label --- the value committed to the form is always the raw input.

  ```ts
  freeEntryText={(str) => `Add "${str}" as a new tag`}
  ```
- **`loading`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - When true, shows a "Loading options..." row in the dropdown while more options load.
- **`loadingText`** `string` (default: `'Loading options...'`) - Text shown in the loading indicator row.
- **`serialize`** `((value: any) => string) | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Function to convert field values to strings for display
- **`deserialize`** `((value: string) => any) | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Function to convert strings back to field values

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:blur | dispatched | - | - |
| on:focus | forwarded | - | - |
| on:select | dispatched | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to the underlying component via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Form } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { FieldCombobox } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { Button } from 'carbon-components-svelte'

  const items = [
    { value: 'react', label: 'React' },
    { value: 'vue', label: 'Vue' },
    { value: 'svelte', label: 'Svelte' },
    { value: 'angular', label: 'Angular' }
  ]

  async function submit (data: any) {
    alert(`Selected framework: ${data.framework}`)
    return { success: true, data, messages: [] }
  }
</script>

<Form let:data {submit}>
  <FieldCombobox
    label="Framework"
    path="framework"

    helperText="Select your preferred framework"
    required
  />
  <div class="mt-4">
    <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
  </div>
  <div class="mt-6 p-4">Form data values:</div>

</Form>
```

### FieldMore

Alternatively, you can provide a function to generate the question from the item being deleted. e.g. (item) => `Are you sure you want to delete ${item.name}?`

### FieldMultiselect

- **`freeEntryText`** `(str: string) => string` - Function to generate the text shown for creating a new entry.
- **`loading`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - When true, shows a "Loading options..." row pinned at the bottom of the dropdown while more options load; selected values stay at the top and in the trigger.
- **`loadingText`** `string` (default: `'Loading options...'`) - Text shown in the loading indicator row.
- **`number`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Whether the values should be treated as numbers.
- **`json`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to true to serialize/deserialize as JSON
- **`serialize`** `((value: any) => string)` - Custom function to serialize values for form submission
- **`deserialize`** `((value: string) => any)` - Custom function to deserialize values from form data

| on:keyup | forwarded | - | - |

### FieldUpload

> A form field component wrapping Carbon's FileUploader with validation and state management.

Import: `import { FieldUpload } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`labelText`** `string` **(required)** - The label text to act as a title above the button or dropzone.
- **`multiple`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set this to true if you want to allow multiple files to be uploaded. The button will become a dropzone instead.
- **`hideLabel`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set this if you are placing the field inside a larger structure like a table. The label will still be read by screen readers.
- **`helperText`** `string` (default: empty string) - Extra information to help the user understand what to do. Good place for instructions about which file types are allowed and the maximum file size.
- **`showHelperTextBelowInput`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - When true, the helper text will be shown below the input instead of above it. This is useful when the input has limited space.
- **`required`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - When true, the field is marked as required in the UI. This is only for visual indication and does not affect validation. Validation is handled by the API that receives the data.
- **`buttonLabel`** `string` (default: `'Upload'`) - The label text for the button or dropzone.
- **`dropZoneLabel`** `string` (default: `'Drag and drop files or click to upload.'`) - The label text for the dropzone area.
- **`dropzoneSize`** `'small' | 'default' | 'large'` (default: `'default'`) - If multiple is true, this may be set to control the size (height) of the dropzone.
- **`hideButtonAfterUpload`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, the upload button will disappear after upload. This is useful in places like ColumnList, Structured list, or somewhere the vertical space is limited. Note, this is not available for multiple uploads.
- **`iconOnlyError`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - If true, error messages will only show as icons without descriptive text.
- **`progress`** `number | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Optional 0-to-1 ratio. When provided, a determinate Carbon ProgressBar is shown below the file list while the form is submitting (and Carbon's per-file spinner is hidden). When left undefined, no ProgressBar is rendered and Carbon's per-file spinner indicates upload activity. Update this from your upload helper's byte-progress callback (e.g. `graphqlWithUploads`'s `progress` option).

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:blur | dispatched | - | - |
| on:focus | dispatched | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to the underlying component via `$$restProps`.

### Form

> A form component with built-in validation, submission handling, and unsaved changes protection.

Import: `import { Form } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`store`** `FormStore<T>` (default: `undefined`) - Form store instance that manages form state
- **`submit`** `((state: T) => Promise<SubmitResponse<T>>) | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Function called when form is submitted. Should return a Promise that resolves with submission results
- **`validate`** `((state: T) => Promise<Feedback[]>) | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Function called to validate form data. Should return a Promise that resolves with array of validation messages
- **`preload`** `T | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Initial form data to preload
- **`submitText`** `string` (default: `'Submit'`) - Text to display on the submit button
- **`hideFallbackMessage`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Whether to hide the fallback validation error message
- **`submitIcon`** `typeof SvelteComponent | Component` (default: `Save`) - Icon component to display on submit button
- **`unsavedWarning`** `boolean | string | { heading?: string, message?: string }` (default: `false`) - Show a warning when navigating away with unsaved changes. Pass `true` to enable with the default heading and message, a string to customize just the message, or an object to customize the `heading` and/or `message`. Browser tab close / quit / hard reload triggers the native browser prompt instead, whose text cannot be customized.
- **`disableSaveUntilChanged`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Whether to disable the save button until form values have changed

#### Slots

| Slot | Slot Props | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| default | `{ messages: Feedback[], saved: boolean, validating: boolean, submitting: boolean, valid: boolean, invalid: boolean, data: T, allMessages: Feedback[], showingInlineErrors: boolean, hasUnsavedChanges: boolean }` | - |
| submit | `{ saved: boolean, validating: boolean, submitting: boolean, valid: boolean, invalid: boolean, allMessages: Feedback[], showingInlineErrors: boolean, hasUnsavedChanges: boolean, saveDisabled: boolean }` | - |

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:autosaved | forwarded | - | - |
| on:saved | forwarded | - | - |
| on:validationfail | forwarded | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to the underlying component via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Form, FieldTextInput, FieldSelect, FieldTextArea } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import type { Feedback, SubmitResponse } from '@txstate-mws/svelte-forms'

  interface FormData {
    textInput: string
    selectInput: string
    textarea: string
  }

  async function handleSubmit (data: FormData): Promise<SubmitResponse<FormData>> {
    return {
      success: false,
      messages: [{ path: 'textInput', message: 'That is invalid.', type: 'error' }],
      data
    }
  }

  async function validateForm (data: FormData): Promise<Feedback[]> {
    return [
      { path: 'textInput', message: 'That is invalid.', type: 'error' }
    ]
  }
</script>

<Form submit={handleSubmit} validate={validateForm} let:data>
  <FieldTextInput
    path="textInput"
    labelText="Text Field"
    required
  />

  <FieldSelect
    path="selectInput"
    labelText="Word Number"
    items={[
      { value: 'one', label: 'One' },
      { value: 'two', label: 'Two' },
      { value: 'three', label: 'Three' },
      { value: 'four', label: 'Four', disabled: true }
    ]}
  />

  <FieldTextArea
    path="textarea"
    labelText="Text Area"
  />
</Form>
```

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from 'carbon-components-svelte'
  import { sleep } from 'txstate-utils'
  import { PanelFormDialog } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { FieldTextInput } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { FieldRadio } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'
  import { FieldTextArea } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'

  let panelOpen = false
</script>

<Button on:click={() => { panelOpen = true }}>Open Panel</Button>

<PanelFormDialog
  title="Create Thing"
  submit={async (data) => { await sleep(1000); return { success: true, data, messages: [] } }}
  open={panelOpen}
  on:cancel={() => { panelOpen = false }}
  on:saved={e => { alert('Saved: ' + JSON.stringify(e.detail, null, 2)); panelOpen = false }}
  unsavedWarning
  disableSaveUntilChanged
  let:data>
  <FieldTextInput path="name" labelText="Name" required defaultValue="Default name" autofocus />
  <FieldRadio path="type" legendText="Type" orientation="vertical" items={[
    { label: 'Animal', value: 'animal' },
    { label: 'Vegetable', value: 'vegetable', disabled: true },
    { label: 'Mineral', value: 'mineral' },
    { label: 'Other', value: 'other' }
  ]} defaultValue="animal" notNull required />
  {#if data.type === 'other'}<FieldTextInput path="othertype" labelText="Other Type" required />{/if}
  <FieldTextArea path="additionalInfo" labelText="Additional information" maxCount={250} defaultValue="More details" />
  <pre style="margin-top: 1em">{JSON.stringify({ data }, null, 2)}</pre>
</PanelFormDialog>
```

### FieldMultiselectPills

> The purpose of FieldMultiselect is to provide a Field with text input having a popup menu that displays, or completes, choice selections based on what's been typed in the text input. Selected choices will be added to a list of selected items, in a pill format, that provides a means for tracking and removing existing selections. The choices listed in the popup are controlled by the parent component via the `getOptions` function that will be used as a debounced callback on the contents of the text input.

Import: `import { FieldMultiselectPills } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'`

<!-- no upstream doc at this version; props extracted from the component source -->

#### Props

- **`path`** `string` **(required)**
- **`getOptions`** `(search: string) => Promise<PopupMenuItem[]>` **(required)** - Function to pass to the component that tells it how to use the text in the text input to determine what `PopupMenuItem[]` should be displayed in the `<PopupMenu>`. Items already 'selected' from the popup menu will be tracked and automatically filtered from the popup if returned as one of the `PopupMenuItem[]` by `getOptions`.
- **`id`** (default: `randomid()`)
- **`labelText`** `string` (default: `''`)
- **`placeholder`** (default: `''`) - Text to display in the text input when it's empty.
- **`disabled`** (default: `false`) - When there are no items (e.g. it's a filtered search and there were no results), we still display one disabled item in the menu to let the user know what is going on. Use this prop to specify the message.
- **`defaultValue`** `string[]` (default: `[]`)
- **`conditional`** `boolean | undefined` (default: `undefined`)
- **`required`** (default: `false`)
- **`maxSelections`** (default: `0`) - Max number of selections to be allowed before disabling the input - 0 for unlimited.
- **`lookupByValue`** `(val: string) => Promise<PopupMenuItem | undefined>` (default: `async (val) => { const options = await getOptions(val); return options.find((opt) => opt.value === val) }`)
- **`extradescid`** `string | undefined` (default: `undefined`)
- **`helperText`** `string | undefined` (default: `undefined`)

### FieldUploadTable

Import: `import { FieldUploadTable } from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte'`

Rows can optionally include an uploadConfig property to override component-level upload settings (accept, helperText, multiple, required, dropzoneSize, hideButtonAfterUpload, buttonLabel, dropZoneLabel).

- **`helperText`** (default: `''`) - Helper text shown for all upload fields. Can be overridden per-row via uploadConfig.
- **`multiple`** (default: `false`) - Allow multiple file uploads per row. Can be overridden per-row via uploadConfig.
- **`required`** (default: `false`) - Mark all upload fields as required. Can be overridden per-row via uploadConfig.
- **`dropzoneSize`** `'small' | 'default' | 'large'` (default: `'small'`) - Size of the dropzone when multiple is true. Can be overridden per-row via uploadConfig.
- **`hideButtonAfterUpload`** (default: `false`) - Hide upload button after file is uploaded. Can be overridden per-row via uploadConfig.

### Accordion

> An accordion component from Carbon

Import: `import { Accordion } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`align`** `"start" | "end"` (default: `"end"`) - Specify alignment of accordion item chevron icon.
- **`size`** `"sm" | "xl"` (default: `undefined`) - Specify the size of the accordion.
- **`disabled`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to disable the accordion
- **`skeleton`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to display the skeleton state

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:click | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseenter | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseleave | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseover | forwarded | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to the underlying component via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script>
  import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from 'carbon-components-svelte'

  let open = [true, false, false]
  
  function handleToggle(index) {
    // Create a new array to ensure reactivity
    const newOpen = [...open]
    newOpen[index] = !newOpen[index]
    open = newOpen
  }
</script>

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem 
    title="Section 1" 
    bind:open={open[0]} 
    on:toggle={() => handleToggle(0)}
  >
    <p>This is the content for section 1. The accordion allows users to expand and collapse sections of content as needed.</p>
  </AccordionItem>
  
  <AccordionItem 
    title="Section 2" 
    bind:open={open[1]} 
    on:toggle={() => handleToggle(1)}
  >
    <p>This is the content for section 2. Accordions are useful for organizing and presenting information in a compact format.</p>
  </AccordionItem>
  
  <AccordionItem 
    title="Section 3" 
    bind:open={open[2]} 
    on:toggle={() => handleToggle(2)}
  >
    <p>This is the content for section 3. You can customize the appearance and behavior of accordion items as needed.</p>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

<p>Currently open sections: {open.map((isOpen, i) => isOpen ? `Section ${i+1}` : '').filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'None'}</p>
```

### Button

> A button component from Carbon

Import: `import { Button } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`kind`** `"primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary" | "ghost" | "danger" | "danger-tertiary" | "danger-ghost"` (default: `"primary"`) - Specify the kind of button.
- **`size`** `"default" | "field" | "small" | "lg" | "xl"` (default: `"default"`) - Specify the size of button. When the `badge` slot is used, size is set to `lg` per Carbon design guidelines.
- **`expressive`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to use Carbon's expressive typesetting
- **`isSelected`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to enable the selected state for an icon-only, ghost button.
- **`icon`** `Icon` (default: `undefined`) - Specify the icon to render. Alternatively, use the named slot "icon".

  ```svelte
  <Button>
    <Icon slot="icon" size={20} />
  </Button>
  ```
- **`iconDescription`** `string` (default: `undefined`) - Specify the ARIA label for the button icon. On an icon-only button, this also drives Carbon's tooltip. If omitted, the icon-only button renders without a tooltip; supply your own `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` for accessibility in that case.
- **`tooltipAlignment`** `"start" | "center" | "end"` (default: `"center"`) - Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the icon. Only applies to icon-only buttons.
- **`tooltipPosition`** `"top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left"` (default: `"bottom"`) - Set the position of the tooltip relative to the icon.
- **`hideTooltip`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to hide the tooltip while maintaining accessibility. Only applies to icon-only buttons. When `true`, the tooltip is visually hidden but the `iconDescription` remains accessible to screen readers.
- **`as`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to render a custom HTML element. Props are destructured as `props` in the default slot.

  ```svelte
  <Button let:props>
    <div {...props}>Custom Element</div>
  </Button>
  ```
- **`skeleton`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to display the skeleton state
- **`disabled`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to disable the button
- **`href`** `string` (default: `undefined`) - Set the `href` to use an anchor link.
- **`tabindex`** `number | string | undefined` (default: `"0"`) - Specify the tabindex
- **`type`** `string` (default: `"button"`) - Specify the `type` attribute for the button element
- **`ref`** `null | HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLButtonElement` (default: `null`) - Obtain a reference to the HTML element. Bindable (readonly).
- **`portalTooltip`** `boolean | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Set to `true` to render the icon-only tooltip in a portal, preventing it from being clipped by `overflow: hidden` containers and enabling auto-flipping when the preferred direction lacks space. By default, the tooltip is portalled when inside a `Modal`.

#### Slots

| Slot | Slot Props | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| default | `{ props: { role: "button"; type?: string; tabindex: any; disabled: boolean; href?: string; class: string; [key: string]: any } }` | - |
| badge | - | Compose a `BadgeIndicator` overlaid on an icon-only button. Size is set to `lg` automatically. |
| icon | `{ style: undefined \| string }` | - |

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:blur | forwarded | - | - |
| on:click | forwarded | - | - |
| on:focus | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mousedown | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseenter | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseleave | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseover | forwarded | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to button | a | div via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button } from 'carbon-components-svelte'
  import { Edit } from 'carbon-icons-svelte'
</script>

<div class="flow">
  <div class="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">

    <Button disabled>Primary disabled</Button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">

    <Button kind="secondary" disabled>Secondary disabled</Button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
    <Button kind="tertiary">Tertiary</Button>
    <Button icon={Edit} kind="tertiary">Tertiary with icon</Button>
    <Button kind="tertiary" disabled>Tertiary disabled</Button>
  </div>
  <div class="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">

    <Button kind="ghost" disabled>Ghost disabled</Button>
```

### CopyButton

> A copy button component from Carbon

Import: `import { CopyButton } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`feedback`** `string` (default: `"Copied!"`) - Set the feedback text shown after clicking the button
- **`feedbackTimeout`** `number` (default: `2000`) - Set the timeout duration (ms) to display feedback text
- **`feedbackIcon`** `Icon` (default: `undefined`) - Specify an icon to render during the feedback window (for example, after copying). When unset, the copy icon is always shown.
- **`iconDescription`** `string` (default: `"Copy to clipboard"`) - Set the title and ARIA label for the copy button
- **`kind`** `"primary" | "ghost"` (default: `"primary"`) - Specify the kind of copy button. Use `"ghost"` to match a `Button` with `kind="ghost"`.
- **`size`** `"sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl"` (default: `"md"`) - Specify the size of the copy button. `"md"` keeps Carbon's native 2.5rem square; the other sizes match `Button`.
- **`text`** `string` (default: `undefined`) - Specify the text to copy.
- **`copy`** `(text: string) => void | Promise<void>` - Override the default copy behavior (navigator.clipboard.writeText).
- **`portalTooltip`** `boolean | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Set how the "Copied!" feedback tooltip is rendered. By default, it is rendered in a portal so it shares the same surface as the hover tooltip (the text swaps in place) and is never clipped by an `overflow: hidden` container. Set to `false` to use Carbon's inline feedback caret instead; a non-default `tooltipPosition`/`tooltipAlignment` still portals because the inline caret only supports the default placement.
- **`tooltipPosition`** `"top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left"` (default: `"bottom"`) - Set the position of the tooltip relative to the button.
- **`tooltipAlignment`** `"start" | "center" | "end"` (default: `"center"`) - Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the button.
- **`ref`** `null | HTMLButtonElement` (default: `null`) - Obtain a reference to the underlying button element.

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:animationend | forwarded | - | - |
| on:blur | forwarded | - | - |
| on:click | forwarded | - | - |
| on:copy | dispatched | - | - |
| on:copy:error | dispatched | - | - |
| on:focus | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseenter | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseleave | forwarded | - | - |

### Icons

> Icons come from `carbon-icons-svelte`.

The upstream doc shows the barrel import. Do not use it - it pulls thousands of components into the
bundle. Deep-import one icon per line:

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Launch from 'carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Launch.svelte'
  import WarningAltFilled from 'carbon-icons-svelte/lib/WarningAltFilled.svelte'
</script>

<Launch size={16} title="Opens in a new tab" />
<WarningAltFilled size={20} class="warn" />

<style>
  /* Recolor by targeting the rendered svg; the component takes no color prop. */
  .warn :global(svg) { fill: var(--cds-support-03, #f1c21b); }
</style>
```

Props: `size` (16 | 20 | 24 | 32), `title` (accessible name - omit for purely decorative icons),
plus anything else forwarded to the `<svg>`. Browse names at
<https://carbon-icons-svelte.onrender.com>.

Where a component prop wants an icon (`ActionItem.icon`, `PromptDefinition.icon`, `Form.submitIcon`),
pass the imported component itself, not an element: `icon: Launch`, not `icon: <Launch />`.

### InlineNotification

> Notification that appears inline.

#### Guidance

`title` and `subtitle` are plain strings and do not accept markup, but carbon-svelte sets `white-space: pre-line` on both, so a `\n` in the string breaks the line and `\n\n` leaves a blank line. The same applies to `ToastNotification` and to a `Feedback` message rendered through `FormInlineNotification`.

Import: `import { InlineNotification } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`kind`** `"error" | "info" | "info-square" | "success" | "warning" | "warning-alt"` (default: `"error"`) - Specify the kind of notification.
- **`lowContrast`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to use the low contrast variant
- **`timeout`** `number` (default: `0`) - Set the timeout duration (ms) to hide the notification after opening it
- **`role`** `"alert" | "log" | "status"` (default: `"alert"`) - Specify the ARIA `role` for the notification container.
- **`title`** `string` (default: empty string) - Specify the title text
- **`subtitle`** `string` (default: empty string) - Specify the subtitle text
- **`hideCloseButton`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to hide the close button
- **`closeButtonDescription`** `string` (default: `"Close notification"`) - Specify the ARIA label for the close button
- **`open`** `boolean` (default: `true`) - Set to `true` to show the notification, `false` to hide it. Bindable (writable).

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:click | forwarded | - | - |
| on:close | dispatched | `{   timeout: boolean; }` | - |
| on:mouseenter | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseleave | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseover | forwarded | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to div via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  title="Error:"
  subtitle="An internal server error occurred."
/>
```

- **`portalMenu`** `boolean | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Set to `true` to render the menu in a portal, allowing it to escape containers with `overflow: hidden`. When inside a Modal, defaults to `true` unless explicitly set to `false`.

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:click | forwarded | - | - |
| on:close | dispatched | `{   trigger: "escape-key" \| "outside-click" \| "toggle" \| "item-select";   /** only present when an item is selected */   index?: number;   /** only present when an item is selected */   text?: string; }` | - |
| on:keydown | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseenter | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseleave | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseover | forwarded | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to button via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script>
  import { OverflowMenu, OverflowMenuItem } from 'carbon-components-svelte'
</script>

<OverflowMenu>
  <OverflowMenuItem text="Print Queue" />
  <OverflowMenuItem
    href="https://www.txst.edu/"
    text="Printer Support"
  />
  <OverflowMenuItem danger text="Clear Print Jobs" />
</OverflowMenu>
```

### StructuredList

Import: `import { StructuredList } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

- **`multiple`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to allow selecting multiple rows

| on:click | forwarded | - | - |

### Tabs

> A tabbed interface component from Carbon for organizing content into separate views.

Import: `import { Tabs } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`selected`** `number` (default: `0`) - Specify the selected tab index. Bindable (writable).
- **`type`** `"default" | "container"` (default: `"default"`) - Specify the type of tabs.
- **`autoWidth`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` for tabs to have an auto-width
- **`dismissible`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to render a dismiss button for each tab
- **`fullWidth`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` for tabs to span the full width of the container
- **`iconOnly`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to render icon-only tabs. Each `Tab` displays only its `icon`; the `label` is used as the accessible name and the tooltip shown on hover and focus.
- **`iconSize`** `"default" | "lg"` (default: `"default"`) - Specify the icon size for icon-only tabs. `"lg"` uses the large scale (48px tabs with a 20px icon); the default scale is 40px tabs with a 16px icon. Only applies when `iconOnly` is `true`.

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:change | dispatched | `number` | - |
| on:dismiss | dispatched | `{ id: string; label: string; disabled: boolean; hasSecondaryLabel: boolean; index: number }` | - |

This component forwards additional props to div via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tabs, Tab, TabContent } from "carbon-components-svelte"
</script>

<Tabs autoWidth={true}>
  <Tab label="Tab label 1" />
  <Tab label="Tab label 2" />
  <Tab label="Tab label 3" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Content 1</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Content 2</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Content 3</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Tabs>
```

### Tooltip

> A tooltip component from Carbon

Import: `import { Tooltip } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`align`** `"start" | "center" | "end"` (default: `"center"`) - Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the icon.
- **`direction`** `"top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left"` (default: `"bottom"`) - Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the button.
- **`open`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to open the tooltip. Bindable (writable).
- **`hideIcon`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to hide the tooltip icon.
- **`icon`** `Icon` (default: `Information`) - Specify the icon to render for the tooltip button. Defaults to `<Information />`.
- **`iconDescription`** `string` (default: `"Show information"`) - Specify the ARIA label for the tooltip button
- **`iconName`** `string` (default: empty string) - Specify the icon name attribute
- **`tabindex`** `number | string | undefined` (default: `"0"`) - Set the button tabindex
- **`tooltipId`** `string` (default: ``ccs-${Math.random().toString(36)}``) - Set an id for the tooltip.
- **`triggerId`** `string` (default: ``ccs-${Math.random().toString(36)}``) - Set an id for the tooltip button.
- **`triggerText`** `string` (default: empty string) - Set the tooltip button text
- **`enterDelayMs`** `number` (default: `100`) - Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before displaying the tooltip.
- **`leaveDelayMs`** `number` (default: `300`) - Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before hiding the tooltip.
- **`ref`** `null | HTMLDivElement` (default: `null`) - Obtain a reference to the trigger text HTML element. Bindable (readonly).
- **`refTooltip`** `null | HTMLDivElement` (default: `null`) - Obtain a reference to the tooltip HTML element. Bindable (readonly).
- **`refIcon`** `null | HTMLDivElement` (default: `null`) - Obtain a reference to the icon HTML element. Bindable (readonly).
- **`portalTooltip`** `boolean | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Set to `true` to render the tooltip in a portal, preventing it from being clipped by `overflow: hidden` containers. By default, the tooltip is portalled when inside a `Modal`.

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:click | forwarded | - | - |
| on:close | dispatched | - | - |
| on:mousedown | forwarded | - | - |
| on:open | dispatched | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to div via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from 'carbon-components-svelte'
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### TooltipDefinition

> A tooltip definition component from Carbon

Import: `import { TooltipDefinition } from 'carbon-components-svelte'`

#### Props

- **`tooltipText`** `string` (default: empty string) - Specify the tooltip text
- **`open`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - Set to `true` to open the tooltip. Bindable (writable).
- **`align`** `"start" | "center" | "end"` (default: `"center"`) - Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the icon.
- **`direction`** `"top" | "bottom"` (default: `"bottom"`) - Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the icon.
- **`id`** `string` (default: ``ccs-${Math.random().toString(36)}``) - Set an id for the tooltip div element
- **`clickToOpen`** `boolean` (default: `false`) - By default, the tooltip is opened on hover or focus. Set to `true` to open the tooltip on click/focus instead of on hover. Unhovering or blurring the tooltip will close it.
- **`enterDelayMs`** `number` (default: `100`) - Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before displaying the tooltip.
- **`leaveDelayMs`** `number` (default: `300`) - Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before hiding the tooltip.
- **`ref`** `null | HTMLButtonElement` (default: `null`) - Obtain a reference to the button HTML element. Bindable (readonly).
- **`portalTooltip`** `boolean | undefined` (default: `undefined`) - Set to `true` to render the tooltip in a portal, preventing it from being clipped by `overflow: hidden` containers. By default, the tooltip is portalled when inside a `Modal`.

#### Events

| Event | Type | Detail | Description |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| on:click | forwarded | - | - |
| on:close | dispatched | - | - |
| on:focus | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseenter | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseleave | forwarded | - | - |
| on:mouseover | forwarded | - | - |
| on:open | dispatched | - | - |

This component forwards additional props to span via `$$restProps`.

#### Example

```svelte
<script>
  import { TooltipDefinition } from 'carbon-components-svelte'
</script>

<TooltipDefinition
  tooltipText="Boko the bobcat, known for its fierceness and courage, was adopted by the university as its mascot in 1921. "
>
  Boko
</TooltipDefinition>
```

```typescript
/**
 * Represents an action item in a navigation menu.
 * @interface ActionItem
 * @property {string} label - The label of the action item.
 * @property {typeof SvelteComponent} [icon] - Optional icon to display with the action item.
 * @property {string} [href] - Optional link for navigation.
 * @property {() => void | Promise<void>} [onClick] - Optional click handler for the action item.
 * @property {boolean} [showLoading] - If true, the button will show a loading indicator and disable
 *   all other actions while the onClick Promise is unresolved. Use this when the action is expected
 *   to take more than a few hundred milliseconds.
 * @property {boolean} [disabled] - Whether the action item is disabled.
 * @property {boolean} [forceToOverflow] - If true, the action item will always be placed in the overflow menu,
 */
export interface ActionItem {
  label: string
  icon?: any
  href?: string
  onClick?: () => void | Promise<void>
  showLoading?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  forceToOverflow?: boolean
}
```

```typescript
/**
```
```typescript
 * Represents an Image in a Card component..

 * @property {'top' | 'above-tags' | 'below-tags' | 'bottom'} [position='top'] - Where to position the image within the card
 * @property {'object-bottom' | 'object-center' | 'object-left' | 'object-left-bottom' | 'object-left-top' | 'object-right' | 'object-right-bottom' | 'object-right-top' | 'object-top'} [anchor='object-center'] - Tailwind object-position class shorthand for controlling image cropping position.
 * @property {'square' | 'widescreen' | 'standard' | string} [lockedAspect] - Lock image to specific aspect ratio with cropping. Use predefined values ('square'=1:1, 'widescreen'=16:9, 'standard'=4:3) or any custom ratio like '21/9', '3/2', etc. If undefined, image fills container and crops as needed (unlocked)

 */

  | 'object-right-bottom'

  height?: string
}
```

### ColumnDefinition

```typescript
/**
 * Represents a column in a data table or grid.
 * @interface ColumnDefinition
 * @property {string} id - Unique identifier for the column.
 * @property {string} label - Display label for the column header.
 * @property {boolean} [describesRow] - Use this to choose column(s) particularly useful for identifying the row like a name or title.
 * @property {string} [fixed] - Fixed width for the column (CSS size string).
 * @property {number} [grow] - Grow factor for column width distribution.
 * @property {string} [get] - Property path to get cell value from row data.
 * @property {(row: T) => string} [render] - Function to render cell content as HTML.
 * @property {typeof SvelteComponent} [component] - Svelte component for cell rendering.
 * @property {(row: T) => TagItem[]} [tags] - Function to render cell content as tags.
 * @property {{ icon: typeof SvelteComponent, label?: string } | ((row: T) => { icon: typeof SvelteComponent, label?: string } | undefined)} [icon] - Icon configuration.
 * @property {(row: T) => undefined | string} [href] - Function to generate cell link URL.
 * @property {(row: T) => undefined | string} [onClick] - Click handler for cell.
 * @property {string | ((row?: T) => undefined | string | string[])} [class] - CSS class(es) for cell.
 */
export interface ColumnDefinition<T> {
  id: string
  label: string

  /**
   * Mark this column as particularly useful for identifying the row. For instance, a name
   * column.
   *
   * All `describesRow` columns will be used as aria-describedby targets for interactive objects
   * that affect a single row, i.e. selection checkboxes, the row expansion button, and action
   * buttons. This will greatly improve screen reader navigation.
   *
   * If you do not provide a `describesRow` column, the first column with id `name` or `title`
   * will be used as the descriptive column, or if neither of those are present, the first column
   * will be used.
   */
  describesRow?: boolean
  /**
   * One of the two options for specifying the width of the column. Sets the column
   * to a fixed total width (including padding) regardless of which other columns
   * are present.
   *
   * Provide any CSS size string, e.g. '22rem' or '15%' or '50px'.
   *
   * Use sparingly, and generally for small columns. If the fixed width of all columns is
   * greater than what's available on screen, columns will not line up properly from
   * row to row.
   *
   * Also note that checkbox and action columns are automatic and will add to your row width,
   * so if you provide a `fixed` for every column and it adds to 100%, the checkbox or action
   * column may push you over 100%.
   */
  fixed?: string
  /**
   * After all fixed columns have their width, the remaining available width on screen will
   * be divided among columns that use grow. Provide a number that reflects how many shares
   * this column should receive. For instance, if two columns use `grow`, one with `grow: 4`
   * and one with `grow: 6`, the one with `grow: 4` will receive 40% of the remaining available
   * width after fixed columns are accounted for, and the one with `grow: 6` will receive 60%.
   *
   * If you do not provide either `fixed` or `grow`, the default is `grow: 1`.
   */
  grow?: number

  /**
   * Minimum width in pixels for this column when using autoHideColumns.
   * Overrides the default average min-width for this specific column.
   * Useful for columns that need more or less space than average.
   */
  minWidth?: number

  /**
   * When true, this column will never be hidden by autoHideColumns even if
   * it doesn't fit. Use sparingly for critical columns.
   */
  alwaysShow?: boolean

  /**
   * One of four options for specifying the content of a cell. Specify a property name
   * or a dot-separated path. The content of the cell will be the value of that property/path
   * in the row object.
   */
  get?: string
  /**
   * Second of four options for specifying the content of a cell. Provide a function that accepts
   * a row object and returns HTML for the cell content.
   */
  render?: (row: T) => string
  /**
   * Third of four options for specifying the content of a cell. Provide a Svelte component. It will
   * be given the row object as a prop named `row`.
   */
  component?: any
  /**
   * Last of four options for specifying the content of a cell. Provide a function that accepts
   * a row object and returns an array of tags you would like rendered in the cell. All interactive tags
   * in a row will be grouped into a single set for keyboard users to arrow through.
   */
  tags?: (row: T) => TagItem[]

  /**
   * Add an icon to the beginning of the cell content. Works in tandem with one of the four options for specifying
   * cell content.
   */
  icon?:
  | { icon: any, label?: string }
  | ((row: T) => { icon: any, label?: string } | undefined)
  /**
   * Wrap the entire cell in a link. Works in tandem with one of the four options for specifying cell content.
   * Probably not a good idea to provide this for a cell containing interactive elements.
   */
  href?: (row: T) => undefined | string
  /**
   * Wrap the entire cell in a button. Works in tandem with one of the four options for specifying cell content.
   * Probably not a good idea to provide this for a cell containing interactive elements.
   *
   * If you provide both an href and an onClick, the cell will be wrapped with an `a` tag and the onClick be placed on
   * it. The onClick will fire but not necessarily before the navigation begins.
   */
  onClick?: (row: T) => undefined | string

  /**
   * Optionally add a CSS class to the cell's container. It will not necessarily be a td.
   *
   * If you provide a function, it will be called once without a row and you can return a class for the
   * column header cell.
   */
  class?: string | ((row?: T) => undefined | string | string[])
}
```

### StepType

```typescript
/**
 * current - The step is where the user is currently located.
 * complete - The step has been completed.
 * dependent - The step is dependent on other steps, for example, a review screen is
 *   incomplete until the user has completed the previous steps... it cannot be
 *   completed by visiting the review screen so 'available' and 'future' are inappropriate.
 * available - The step is incomplete, available to be completed, but is not the current
 *   step. This can also be used for optional steps once they become available.
 * future - The step is not available to be completed yet, but is expected to become so.
 * warning - The step is available but has a warning in it. current step should still be marked as current
 * error - The step is available but also has an error in it. current step should still be marked as current
 */
export type StepType =
  | 'current'
  | 'complete'
  | 'dependent'
  | 'futuredependent'
  | 'available'
  | 'future'
  | 'warning'
  | 'error'
```

## Appendix: version drift, deep imports, sources

### Documented upstream, not available at this version

The design-system doc site tracks carbon-svelte's main branch and runs ahead of what a ReqQuest
project resolves. These are documented there but are **not** exported by the version in the table at
the top of this file, so importing them will not compile. They are omitted from the catalog above:

- `FieldRichText`

Two known cases and where they actually live:

- **`FieldRichText`** - a CKEditor 5 field, shipped separately as
  `@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte-ckeditor`, not from the main package.
- **`ExpandCollapseAll`** - not exported at this version.

### Exported but not on the doc site

Any entry above carrying an `<!-- no upstream doc at this version -->` marker had its props read out
of the component source instead. Those entries have no example and no events table; the props are
accurate but thin. `LoadingIcon`, `ScrollOverflow`, `SiteMap`, `FormInlineNotification`,
`FieldMultiselectPills`, `FieldUploadTable` and the skeleton family are usually in this bucket.

### Present in `dist/` but not re-exported

These exist in the package but are not in its barrel, so they need a deep import and are not covered
above. Treat them as internal; the barrel is the supported surface.

```ts
import BreadcrumbNav from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte/dist/BreadcrumbNav.svelte'
import LoadingBar from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte/dist/LoadingBar.svelte'
import ProgressNavStep from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte/dist/ProgressNavStep.svelte'
import TagSkeleton from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte/dist/TagSkeleton.svelte'
import UserImpersonation from '@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte/dist/UserImpersonation.svelte'
```

`@reqquest/ui` has one of these too: `DelayedSkeleton` is compiled into `dist/components/` but is not
re-exported from the barrel. The framework's own screens use it via `$lib`; downstream code should
register a `loader` on the prompt instead of mounting it directly.

### When this file is not enough

- **Props, exactly.** `carbon-svelte` ships unbundled, so
  `node_modules/@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte/dist/<Name>.svelte` is the real source with its JSDoc
  intact, and `dist/<Name>.svelte.d.ts` beside it has the resolved prop types.
- **Item and definition shapes.** `node_modules/@txstate-mws/carbon-svelte/dist/util.d.ts` is the
  single best reference - `ColumnDefinition`, `ActionItem`, `TagItem`, `NavigationItem`,
  `ShellItem`, `UserProfile` and friends, all heavily commented.
- **The ReqQuest contract.** `node_modules/@reqquest/ui/dist/registry.d.ts` carries the full
  `UIConfig` and `PromptDefinition` JSDoc, and `dist/keys.d.ts` explains the key augmentation.
- **Keys and registration end to end.** `docs/downstream-setup.md` in the reqquest repo.
- **Live examples.** The design-system site renders every component with source:
  <https://component-library.app.qual.txst.edu>.

### Sources and regeneration

The carbon-svelte sections of this file are generated. The design-system team publishes machine
-readable docs at:

- <https://component-library.app.qual.txst.edu/llms.txt> - the index
- <https://component-library.app.qual.txst.edu/llms-full.txt> - everything in one file
- `https://component-library.app.qual.txst.edu/llms/<Name>.md` - one component

Anything else on that host answers `200` with the SPA shell rather than a `404`, so a fetch has to
sniff the body, not the status. The generator does.

To rebuild after a carbon-svelte bump:

```
cd ui
npm run docs:components          # regenerate ui/src/lib/components.md
npm run docs:components:check    # CI gate: fails if the committed file is stale
```

Every `svelte` fence in the Recipes section is meant to compile as written. To re-verify after
editing one, extract the fences into a scratch folder inside a real project's `src/local` and run
`npx svelte-check` there - `ColumnList`'s requirement that row types carry an `id` was caught that
way, not by reading.

Hand-written sections live in `ui/docs-src/components/`. To replace a generated entry with a
hand-written one, drop a file at `ui/docs-src/components/overrides/<Name>.md` and it is used
verbatim. Do not edit `components.md` directly - the next build discards it.

The file ships to downstream projects because `svelte-package` copies non-code files out of
`src/lib` into `dist`, and `package.json` ships `"files": ["dist"]`. Downstream it is at
`ui/node_modules/@reqquest/ui/dist/components.md`.
